label: early original-phase a/t (step 2) after prefix starting with e or with y second
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (~0.03% of steps). Fires only in the original phase at t=2 (75% of mass) or t=3 (25%), and never at the delimiter or during copy. The input token is almost always a (76% of mass), sometimes t (21%) or q (3%). Whether it fires depends on the earlier prefix: it is strongest when the sequence starts with e and/or y comes just before the input (all top examples are e y [a]); first tokens v, n, h, u and previous tokens y, r, d also help. Looks like a thresholded additive conjunction of position, current token and prefix tokens. a/t at t=2 or 3 alone catches 93% of activations but with only 3% precision; adding the prefix condition gives dev F1 0.46 (P 0.42, R 0.51, mass recall 0.64). Not active on a/t later in the sequence or on other tokens.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & in_tok=a (+3.33), orig0=e (+3.22), prev2_tok=e (+3.17), prev_tok=y (+2.85), prev2_tok=v (+2.52), orig0=h (+2.37). Lower it: prev_tok=1 (-1.76), orig8=- (-0.65), n_digits=1 (-0.40).
